edits.before: - Vex Personal Space (Fear): matchup-defining — Shield + AoE fear that punishes dashes — never dash onto her while her passive glows. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W gold card has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Personal Space (W): 16s at rank 1, 12s max — her shield is the fight; trade in the window after she burns it. - Doom 'n Gloom fears off her next empowered ability — watch the glow, not her HP bar. - Shadow Surge (R): 140s at rank 1 — while it's down, your Destiny roams go unanswered.
